assets.name: DeathSwitch
assets.prompt: Create one production-ready circular dark fantasy game ability icon for Survivalcraft mod Abyss Reaper. Subject: two interlocked crescent scythe blades around a split emblem, one violet spatial rift half and one pale bone death skull half, clear readable dual-authority transformation symbol. Centered composition, isolated circular forged gunmetal border, transparent outside circle, genuine alpha background. Black/purple void palette, cold ivory highlights distinguish death authority; strong silhouette readable at 72 pixels. Ornate but restrained, highly polished painted game inventory art. No letters, no text, no watermark, no grid, no extra icons, no colored square background. Output a single square PNG icon.
